sources.title: Geist and Geist Mono, variable web fonts, release v1.9.2

license.name: SIL Open Font License 1.1
license.conditions: The fonts may be used, bundled, embedded and redistributed with the app, never sold by themselves; the copyright notice and the licence travel with every copy: it is OFL.txt beside this record, served with the app at /fonts/geist/OFL.txt. No Reserved Font Name is declared.

sources.note: Copyright 2026 The Geist Project Authors (OFL.txt). The files are the release tag's own, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at the tag's commit by scripts/fetch_download.py and pinned in data/downloads.json; the release's zip asset holds web fonts that differ by a few hundred bytes, which build is newer could not be read without a font tool, and the renderings were compared before choosing.

files.note: The tag's fonts/Geist/webfonts/Geist[wght].woff2, byte for byte: Geist, every weight (the app uses 300 to 600).
The tag's fonts/GeistMono/webfonts/GeistMono[wght].woff2, byte for byte: Geist Mono, every weight (the app uses 400 and 500).
The release's licence text, byte for byte (the same in the tag and in the release's zip). It must travel with the fonts.
